newsitem.title: CANADA: Agrium to issue debt, buy back shares.
newsitem.headline: Agrium to issue debt, buy back shares.

text.p: Agrium Inc said on Thursday it has filed a preliminary prospectus and registration statement for a U.S. offering of three series of debt securities worth a total of US$300 million.

Agrium also said it will soon begin a "substantial" issuer bid under which it will repurchase up to 13.9 million common shares on a modified dutch auction basis at a price between C$20 and C$23 per share.

Agrium will offer three series of senior unsecured debt. The first series will be US$75 million in notes due 2004. The second will be US$100 million of debentures due 2017 while the third series will be US$125 million of debentures due 2027.
Merrill Lynch will act as lead manager for the offering. The syndicate will also include J.P. Morgan Securities Inc, RBC Dominion Securities Corp and Smith Barney Inc.

Under the bid, shareholders can deposit common shares at prices selected by them ranging from C$20 to C$23 per share, with the price to be paid under the bid being a clearing price that will allow Agrium to acquire the number of shares sought.
Agrium said the aggregate purchase price under the bid will be US$208 million to US$239 million, based on the current exchange rate.
Agrium will mail a circular containing terms of the bid, which is expected to be completed mid-February, shortly.
The soliciting dealer under the issuer bid is RBC Dominion Securities.
